note: Filed by lane AMEND-PARITY-ALL-ACCOUNTS on manager decision 2026-10-25 19:13Z (session_01MdQiC8UqKBLj287KWFWN71): NOT in PR #20150; the manager takes it to the operator with the LTR-6R bundle; not Monday-critical. EVIDENCE (MEASURED, diag #20148, read 2026-10-25 19:02Z): alpaca_live had 1 live stop replace since 2026-08-01 (TLT OCO stop 3ac4048d replaced f3715f25 on 2026-09-22, 6 top-level orders, not truncated) and holds 0 positions / 0 orders now; alpaca_paper shows the trail PATCH-replace chains (QQQ 730.90->739.99 2026-10-02..05). GAP: AlpacaClient.modify_protective 2xx = ok; no read-back, no tighten-only check, no partial-fill check (Alpaca has 2xx-accepted ineffective ops: PI-20261002-APBY4NTV-0001). DIFF SKETCH (src/units/accounts/execute.py, modify_open_order alpaca branch, ~line 3317): when sl is given and qty>0, replace 'resp = exchange_client.modify_protective(symbol, sl=sl, tp=tp, qty=qty)' with 'from src.units.accounts import alpaca_amend; r = alpaca_amend.tighten(exchange_client, symbol=symbol, direction=side_to_direction(side), qty=qty, new_sl=sl, new_tp=tp, apply=True)' and map r['result']: applied -> ok True; refused 'already_at_or_tighter' -> ok True no-op; refused other / apply_failed / could_not_look -> ok False with error=r['detail'] (the monitor already records a failed modify and retries next tick, no halting). Keep the TP-only path on modify_protective unless tighten's target branch is adopted too. NOTE: tighten refuses a LOOSER stop, which the trail never sends by construction; verify no trail branch relies on loosening first. Tests: extend tests/test_ltmgmt_modify_wiring.py alpaca cases with read-back mismatch -> ok False. Population: ict-trader-live journal 13:30Z-21:10Z read in 154 three-minute windows via /api/diag/journalctl (0 windows hit the 2000-line cap, so coverage is complete); 'exchange modify' lines on ANY account = 0 (positive control: the string is the logger.info at src/runtime/order_monitor.py:1731). No trail moved a stop on any account in the window, so the alpaca_paper read-back has not had a chance to run. Re-checked by the next manager check-in; observation stays open, due_by moved to 2026-10-27T21:00Z. [BACKLOG-DRAIN-2 2026-11-01] PENDING: NOT MET. journalctl ict-trader-live since 2026-10-27 grep 'readback=': 252000 lines scanned, 0 matched, read_state time_budget_hit, truncated true. NOT a negative: the scan stopped early. Needs windows of about one day. [2026-11-15 09:12Z AM-OPS backlog drain slice 2] STILL OPEN (waits): journal 11-14 00:00Z..11-15 ~09:00Z (7 complete windows): 156 'exchange modify for pkg=' lines, all bybit_1/bybit_2/bybit_portfolio, 0 on alpaca, so the read-back never had a chance. Next: an alpaca_paper trail modify in RTH Mon 11-16. Re-dated 11-17. 2026-11-19 16:40Z AM-OPS-8, evidence against landed_unproven. alpaca_portfolio (PAPER mirror) SLV short, slv_trend_1h: 7 open rows on one netted 877-share position (7750 794sh, 7754 53, 7762 19, 7774 5, and 7758/7766/7770 at 2sh each). 16:00Z and 16:14Z: the monitor trail was refused on 7758/7766/7770 with 'ambiguous_legs: 3 stop / 3 target leg(s) of qty=2.0'. The cause is src/units/accounts/alpaca_amend.py read_trade_legs(): it scopes a trade's legs by share count only (abs(lq-qty) <= _QTY_EPS), so three identical 2-share brackets can't be told apart. The trades CAN be told apart: diag alpaca_open_orders 16:31Z shows each stop leg's parent_id equals its row's broker_order_id (stop 6d3cbb68 parent 51f4045b = 7770; d5e0e002 / aa1dff1a = 7766; f6b0077f / c64f9ccc = 7758). sl_order_id/tp_order_id are NULL on all 7 rows. Fix: pass the row's entry order id into read_trade_legs and match legs by parent_id first, keeping qty only as a fallback when the parent is unknown. Same fix makes the trail reach the three 2-share stops; today they rest unmoved at 41.93 / 41.85 / 41.90, while the 19sh and 5sh legs trailed to 41.73. Coverage: the 16:00:19Z alpaca_partial_stop_coverage (858 of 877) is 877-858=19 = the 19-share leg's stop f28a3e4c, resubmitted 16:00 (replace in flight; see ALPACA-AMEND-REPLACE-RACE). It is NOT the 2-share rows. At 16:31Z the stops cover 794+53+19+5+2+2+2 = 877 = the full position. No live action. 2026-11-19 17:40Z AM-OPS-8, follow-up at the manager's request. The 17:25-17:27Z live-review packets for the SLV mirror 2-share legs (pkg-23338a53 / 877c317b / 9f063ca3) say 'no resting TP found at the venue read' with mechanics verdict 'match'. They are NOT naked of TP: it is a read-attribution gap. diag alpaca_open_orders 17:38Z shows 7 resting TP limits summing 794+53+19+5+2+2+2 = 877 = the position. Each maps by price to its row's journal take_profit_1: 7770 37.613 -> ff6db55a 37.61; 7766 37.563 -> d60bb8ad 37.56; 7758 37.643 -> a1200108 37.64; 7774 37.613 -> 6433abc5 (5sh); 7762 37.643 -> c9df8fb6 (19sh); 7754 37.343 -> a810fbd9; 7750 37.283 -> 96ce12cd. The packet matched 'tp:symbol' among 6 siblings and gave up on three identical qty-2 targets. Two defects for the order-id fix: (a) in the flat open-orders read the TP legs carry NO parent_id (parent '-' on all 7 TP legs; submitted_at 2026-11-18 14:31-14:34Z, i.e. replaced/re-armed after entry), while the stop legs do carry parent = the row's broker_order_id. So parent_id disambiguates stops only; TPs need the nested /v2/orders?nested=true parent->legs read, or a match on the row's journal TP price to the cent. (b) The packet's mechanics verdict reads 'match' while its evidence says no TP was found. An unattributable leg should read could_not_attribute, never match. Priority: TP doctrine is met at the venue, so not urgent; the order-id fix should cover both legs. Paper only.
